title: stc recording (media/segments manifest), v1
description: What media a take is made of, as a list of segments (STC-307). A take today is always exactly one segment spanning the whole recording; the array exists so re-take (swap a segment's media, keep the edit), N-minute segmentation and display hot-swap rebuild have somewhere to put their extra segments without a schema break. A segment's media ids are stable, content-independent identities — a re-take replaces the file behind an id, it does not mint a new one. This document is capture-adjacent (what exists), not the edit (project.json says how it is rendered) and not the immutable per-session clock facts (anchors.json). Times are session-relative integer ns, matching anchors and project.

id.description: content-independent identity; stable across a re-take of this media

file.description: path beside this document, as anchors.files.* names it today

endNs.description: must be greater than this segment's own startNs; a sum constraint the schema cannot express alone, so the loader checks it
